title: A self-billed invoice reaches AccountingHub as today
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a test organization whose invoices go to AccountingHub, and sign in to its AccountingHub company in a second tab.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, for $90.00, that bills itself.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Create Invoice.
  4. In AccountingHub, open the invoice with work order 1's invoice number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab shows Create Invoice.

Step 3:

  • The invoice is created.

Step 4:

  • The AccountingHub invoice is on customer A for $90.00, as it would be today.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12320 (Story 18, AccountingHub)

  • S18-N1: “When the customer pays for itself, AccountingHub receives what it receives today.”
  • Goals: “A shop that never picks a different Bill To sees every total, balance, report and document unchanged.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
